name: Rainbrand
summary: Brand layer that keeps shared identity, guidance and assets current for your AI agents and products.
description: Rainbrand builds and maintains shared brand context from your websites, brand guides and files, then gives agents the guidance and assets they need for campaigns, sites, slides, email and video. You can use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Codex or Cursor, or embed it in a product through the API. Credit top-ups are billed at plan rates listed on the pricing page.
features: Brand context from sites, guides and files
assets for campaigns and creative work
API and MCP on every plan
